source_locator.edition_or_translation: J. M. Ashmand translation from Proclus's Greek paraphrase; 1900 W. Foulsham & Co. new edition
source_locator.short_quote: for Saturn 57, Jupiter 79, Mars 66, Venus 82, and Mercury 76

prerequisites: the sign-by-sign table in the cited edition
normalized_rule: Under the Egyptian distribution, assign total term degrees of 57 to Saturn, 79 to Jupiter, 66 to Mars, 82 to Venus, and 76 to Mercury, summing to 360 degrees.
synthesis_notes: This source fragment records aggregate Egyptian totals only; it is not a complete sign-by-sign bounds calculator or a universal table.
review_notes: Retain the Egyptian method as an explicit variant. This candidate records the aggregate totals only; the omitted sign-by-sign allocation is not invented. Ashmand says it is the more relied-upon distribution, but that preference does not authorize flattening it with the Chaldaic or Ptolemaic methods.
transmission_notes: The table and totals are reported in Ashmand's Chapter XXIII. The source compares this method with Chaldaic and Ptolemaic distributions; certainty is limited to the cited Ashmand/Proclus transmission.
